lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Mg12Cu4 (DyMg6Cu2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms in the unit cell across 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Dy centers coordinated by 16 neighbors (2 Cu, 14 Mg), Cu centers by 9 neighbors (3 Dy, 6 Mg), and Mg centers in several environments, including a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra with corner- and face-sharing, and Dy–Mg polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing.
